body:
User asked (verbatim, via team-lead brief):
  UP-15 "Upload sessions with expiry — server-issued upload token valid for a window (tus expiration, Supabase signed uploads, Uploadcare). Core." Today there is no recorded upload-session entity. Build the smallest real thing: a session the server issues (key or key prefix, size/type limits, expiry), redeemable for uploads until it expires, refused after; where it lives (upload package with a pluggable store interface, plus a records-backed store) is your call — keep the core stdlib-only. Expired sessions must be sweepable. Security bar: tokens are signed or random-unguessable, expiry always enforced server-side, limits re-checked on the bytes.

Context:
  Files: upload/, records/
Acceptance:
  issue/redeem/expire/sweep sessions with tests
title: UP-15 upload sessions with expiry
